prompt: Create a saved comparison of viable cell density between CHO-007-R01 and CHO-007-R02 and summarize the numerical result. Use exact matching elapsed sample times and define differences as CHO-007-R02 minus CHO-007-R01. Report the mean signed difference, largest absolute difference, its elapsed time in hours, and name both batches. Include the deliveries still in review and state their provisional status.

output.content:
A saved comparison now exists (viable cell density, CHO-007-R02 minus CHO-007-R01, exact matched elapsed times only).

**Result (14 matched time points, 0–193 h):**
- **Mean signed difference: −26,452 cells/mL** (R02 lower than R01 on average).
- **Largest absolute difference: 696,666 cells/mL at 169.0 h** — CHO-007-R01 was 6,086,667 cells/mL and CHO-007-R02 was 6,783,333 cells/mL at that time.

Both batches ran from ~392,000/387,000 cells/mL at 0 h to similar declines by 193 h; other extremes included −453,334 cells/mL at 146 h (R01 higher). All 14 sample times matched exactly with no unmatched times.

**Provisional status:** these values come from the Northfield Biologics · November runs delivery, which is still in review — the figures were read from the delivery files and not yet reviewed by anyone (79 open checks, including missing fields and a duplicate conflict), so nothing here should be treated as verified. Your October runs and Harborview fed-batch deliveries are likewise still in review. This is a descriptive comparison only; no significance test applies, and batch context (product, process version, equipment, scale, stage) was not recorded, so differences cannot be attributed to process conditions.
